newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India issues one-year term tender to buy kerosene.
newsitem.headline: India issues one-year term tender to buy kerosene.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a one-year term tender for the purchase of superior kerosene for delivery from June 1997 to May 1998, traders said on Wednesday.

The tender seeks 40,000-45,0000 tonne cargoes for delivery to Madras or Haldia on the Indian east coast, and 30,000 tonne cargoes for delivery to Bombay on the west coast, both on a cost and freight basis.
The tender closes on April 29 and offers will be valid until May 3.
Last month IOC declined to accept any offers for its initial term tender to buy kerosene for delivery from May 1997 to April 1998.
Traders said IOC usually issues an initial tender to get a feel of the market as was the case last year.
